cjv.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate reduced gray-white matter separability, heavy head motion, or intensity non-uniformity artifacts
caveats: not specific to one artifact type
interpret with CNR, SNR, EFC, and visual report

cnr.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor gray-white matter contrast or increased noise
caveats: depends on tissue segmentation quality

efc.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate ghosting, blurring, or motion-related degradation
caveats: not specific to motion by itself
interpret with SNR, FWHM, CJV, and visual report

fber.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate weak foreground signal relative to background noise
caveats: special values can occur when background signal is absent or post-processed

qi_1.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate artifactual intensity voxels in the background region
caveats: near-zero is expected for clean background
negative or special values may indicate missing background mask context

qi_2.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate abnormal background noise structure after detected artifacts are removed
caveats: less directly interpretable than QI1

wm2max.display_name: White Matter to Maximum Intensity Ratio
wm2max.qc_interpretation: values outside the expected range may indicate abnormal high-intensity tails from vessels, fat, or other hyperintense signal
caveats: treat as supportive evidence, not a standalone failure criterion

snr_*.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor tissue-specific or overall signal quality and can support assessment of motion-related degradation
caveats: the QC book found SNR-derived metrics informative for motion in a T1w motion dataset
interpret by tissue and with visual evidence

snrd_*.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor signal quality relative to background air noise
caveats: depends on valid air/background estimation

fwhm_*.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate a blurrier or less spatially sharp image
caveats: interpret with acquisition resolution and preprocessing context

rpve_*.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate greater partial-volume uncertainty or poorer tissue segmentation
caveats: weak standalone artifact evidence
depends on segmentation quality

icvs_*.qc_interpretation: unusual tissue fractions may provide anatomical or segmentation context but are weak standalone QC evidence
caveats: do not treat as direct artifact evidence without reference distribution

inu_*.qc_interpretation: values further from uniformity may indicate RF bias-field or intensity inhomogeneity
caveats: interpret with CJV and visual intensity shading

tpm_overlap_*.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poorer tissue alignment or segmentation consistency with the template
caveats: can reflect anatomy, registration, or segmentation rather than raw image quality alone

summary_*.qc_interpretation: describes intensity distributions for tissue or background compartments; useful for derived checks but weak as direct model evidence
caveats: usually do not send all summary fields to the model unless specifically flagged

size_*.qc_interpretation: describes image dimensions; useful for comparability but not direct artifact evidence
caveats: do not use as QC failure evidence by itself

spacing_*.qc_interpretation: describes image resolution; useful for comparability but not direct artifact evidence
caveats: do not use as QC failure evidence by itself
